title: Treat user input containing tag characters as text
goal: Use textContent to display raw text to avoid parsing user input into HTML.
summary: The label making tool needs to display code snippets entered by students. Leave the angle brackets, ampersands, and quotation marks intact.
tasks: listens to the input event of #draft and updates the #literal with user input.
Displays the input as is, without creating new HTML elements. Restore "Waiting for input" when input is cleared.

example.note: textContent sets the element content by text. innerHTML will parse the content within the angle brackets as markup.

hint: reads the value of the input box, it is directly assigned to the textContent of #literal.
